perf.doc: D3-AC-01 item 3 (AWR-05 §4.8): targets/perception budget cases of D2 (M18-AC-022, M19-AC-010, M19-AC-026). Each repeat is a fresh worker process; metrics are the thread CPU time of the call phase (call_cpu_ms; preemption and run-queue waits of a loaded host are excluded) and the record_property values of the case; median of `repeats` after `warmup` (7 rather than the 3 of ADR-033: single repeats spread 10-40 % on the shared CPU pool), each <= D2 baseline x (1 + max_regression); the baseline is the median of `baseline_repeats` (a single 5-repeat session drifts about 3 % between sessions). Outcomes must equal the D2 baseline (cases that passed on d2 must pass; D2 budget misses stay accepted only while identical). Baseline: baseline.json `perf`, recorded with the d2@928c57b awr package on the dmax CPU pool in a no-load window; host fingerprint (CPU model, Python, numpy, numba) must match. flight60 and fleet-ladder are not part of this step yet
